subject[0].name: VESPER
subject[0].species: paper dragon child
subject[0].colour: pale blue

subject[0].pose: वैस्पर stands at the low wall looking down the valley, worried

subject[1].name: FYURIA
subject[1].species: paper dragon child
subject[1].colour: bright pink-red
subject[1].scale: knee high to a grown-up, the height of a human child
subject[1].pose: फ्यूरिया stands beside वैस्पर at the low wall, relaxed and unconcerned, wings loose

subject[2].name: THE DIYA — a small round clay paper lamp, a shallow dish with a pinched lip and a short cotton wick
subject[2].state: standing on the stone shelf of the niche with a single small flame upright on its wick
setting.place: दादी's courtyard: a small square of pale paper flagstone walled on every side, a low wall of cut paper blocks along the valley side with a square niche set into it, a wooden paper door in the taller wall, and the paper hills of the valley beyond.
light.state: Evening, the sun already below the frame. Warm level light lies across the paper stone, and the sky above the valley holds the last gold.
world.rules:
- the only creatures anywhere in this picture are the ones this prompt names — a world of paper dragons, paper birds and paper animals
- every surface — stone, wood, cloth, banner and sky — is plain blank paper
- THE COURTYARD IS THE ATTACHED PLATE: the same flagstones, the same low wall of cut paper blocks, the same niche in the same place, the same door, the same valley beyond.
- EVERY SURFACE IS CUT PAPER: separate pieces of paper with real thickness, soft rounded cut edges, a fine visible paper grain, and the small soft shadow each piece casts on the one behind it.
- SMALL FORM: वैस्पर, फ्यूरिया are each about knee high to a grown-up, and the low wall rises well above the small dragons' heads.
- VIEWPOINT: A view over the low wall out to the paper hills of the valley below.
